rows: One row per snapshot: each distinct data file in our own daily captures, plus each backfilled copy of the program's own archive.

columns.name: program
columns.meaning: The program's ID. anthropic-cvd for every row today.

columns.name: capture_utc
columns.meaning: When we captured the dashboard page for this snapshot (first capture containing it). For backfill rows, when we copied the program's archived snapshot. For Jon's manual capture of 2026-10-30, the end-of-day bound 2026-10-30T23:59:59Z.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.meaning: SHA-256 of the captured dashboard page (index.html for backfill rows).
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: as_of_utc
columns.meaning: The 'last updated' time the program shows, to the second.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: revision
columns.meaning: The program's revision number.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: candidates
columns.meaning: Findings the program's models flagged before triage.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: reviewed_by_firms
columns.meaning: Findings reviewed by external firms.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: confirmed_valid
columns.meaning: Findings the firms confirmed valid.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: true_positive_pct
columns.meaning: The program's true-positive percentage.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: reported_after_triage
columns.meaning: Reported to maintainers after firm review.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: reported_without_review
columns.meaning: Reported to maintainers without firm review.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: reported_total
columns.meaning: Total reported to maintainers ('disclosed').
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: acknowledged
columns.meaning: Acknowledged by a maintainer.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: patched_lab_count
columns.meaning: Patched, by the program's own 'to our knowledge' count.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: advisories
columns.meaning: Identifiers assigned, as the program counts them.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: cves
columns.meaning: CVE records, as the program counts them.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: ghsas
columns.meaning: GitHub Security Advisories, as the program counts them.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: projects_reported
columns.meaning: Projects with reported findings.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: ledger_entries
columns.meaning: Commitments in the ledger (our count of payload.json ledger entries).
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: revealed_entries
columns.meaning: Ledger entries in the revealed tier (our count).
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: severity_agreement_n
columns.meaning: Number of findings in the program's model-versus-firm severity comparison.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: severity_exact_agreement_pct
columns.meaning: Exact severity agreement, model versus firm, as the program reports it.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: severity_within_one_band_pct
columns.meaning: Agreement within one severity band, as the program reports it.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: program_fix_rate_pct
columns.meaning: The 'fix rate' in the program's data file: fixed findings as a share of REVEALED findings (program_revealed_count), not of all reported findings. Never show it without that denominator.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: program_revealed_count
columns.meaning: The revealed count the fix rate is based on.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: source_kind
columns.meaning: our_capture (our own daily capture) or program_archive_backfill (a copy of the program's own archived snapshot; never first-seen evidence).

columns.name: program_snapshot_label
columns.meaning: For backfill rows, the program's own snapshot label, for example 2026-08-26-1155. Empty otherwise.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: first_seen_by_us
columns.meaning: For our_capture rows, when our first capture containing this snapshot fetched its data file. Empty for backfill rows.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: label
columns.meaning: Always Lab-reported (the counts are the program's).

columns.name: note
columns.meaning: Free text, for example the manual-capture note or the Aug 26, 2026 change in date conventions.
